meta.title: Accelerate now() and update Rosetta artifacts
meta.body_summary: Replace the PRNG in OpNow with a faster xorshift algorithm, update Rosetta golden test outputs and benchmark data, and add MOCHI_NOW_SEED for deterministic seeding.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex replaced slow OpNow PRNG with xorshift; closed without review due to staleness/conflicts after ~9 months.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 37 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. As a small performance PR it was closed—not merged—because it became stale and conflicted with main after ~9 months.

review_details.concern_detail: PR unattended for ~9 months; owner closed because it was too old to resolve conflicts cleanly and content superseded by main.
review_details.performance_claim: Speed up OpNow with xorshift PRNG.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by owner due to staleness and conflicts after long inactivity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small PRNG optimization in a language VM; agent contribution went unreviewed and became stale, showing that even simple perf changes can fail due to process delays.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes test commands with benchmark flag and updated Rosetta golden files, but no explicit before/after timing data in the body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No performance regression reported; PR closed for staleness.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, OpNow random number generation was replaced with a xorshift PRNG for speed; Rosetta golden outputs and benchmark data were regenerated with deterministic seed MOCHI_NOW_SEED=1.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Secondary files update Rosetta golden outputs and benchmark data to reflect the new PRNG behavior.
change_trajectory: Single commit replaces PRNG in OpNow and updates Rosetta artifacts.

review_signals.summary: PR closed as too old to resolve conflicts cleanly; content superseded by main.

collaboration_trajectory: Single commit by tamnd/OpenAI_Codex; no reviews or comments for ~9 months until owner closed PR due to staleness.
